annotations.title: Test the spine as a network

description: Links, loops and single points of failure of the spine; rho2 is the share of core pairs no single disturbance can separate. A full search can take tens of seconds; cuts: false skips it. Give exactly one of package, path or example.

cut_budget.description: Most disturbances to test before reporting robustness as null (default 20000).

cuts.description: Search for single points of failure (default true). Robustness is null when skipped.

example.description: Name of a bundled example from list_examples.

include_geometry.description: Include GeoJSON geometry in the answer (default false).

package.description: A DFM Landscape Package v1 (dfm_package "1.0", WGS84 GeoJSON layers). See https://dendriticforest.com/data-format/

path.description: Path to a Landscape Package .json file on this machine (read, never written).

name: spine_network
title: Test the spine as a network
